rules.statement: A partition action is not an action founded on a cause of action as defined in section 5, but it would be an action under the definition of 'action' given in section 6.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now clearly in a partition action the action itself is not founded upon a wrong. It is an action to give relief against the inconvenience of common possession, so that a partition action at its institution is not an action founded upon a cause of action as defined in section 5, but it would be an action under the definition of 'action' given in section 6."
